t: Channels live: tap a free channel to give it your own note (e.g. Gimbal on receiver) – saved in the settings and config.txt
Channels live: free channels used for a mode in INAV are marked

Channels live: under each used channel the Core shows what it expects (e.g. 2000 = throttle, 1000 = brake / reverse, 1000 = left, button pressed above 1700, switch positions with their action) – the current range is bold
Fix: display during an online update now also shows the new version under UPDATE
Web page: update button and reload button moved up into the menu row (right side), ⚙ button removed – System is in the menu
Channels live: channel badge (CH1, CH2 …) in front of each name, free channels shown as free
Web page: dot next to Mojave shows the connection to the Core – green connected, orange slow, red no connection
Display shows only a big UPDATE and the new version while an online update is loading; after the restart as usual
All lights (LEDs and high beam) go off while an online update is loading
FC tab (Channels live, Connection to FC): only one column, also on a wide screen
High beam is always off after power-on or an update (it no longer comes back at the last level)
Wi-Fi: tap one of your own access points in Networks around the Core to switch to exactly that one
Wi-Fi: every 3 min (disarmed) the Core checks for a much stronger access point of your home Wi-Fi and switches
High beam no longer flashes when the battery is plugged in (pin is set off right after the bootloader)
New: Navi – second display with a moving map (aerial photo or street map), connected by radio (ESP-NOW)
Settings, status and Navi update under Display → Navi, new tile Navi status
Display cockpit: Pitch is only shown when the car lies on its roof (no more red band for small tilt)
Display tile GPS: shows only the number of satellites (no Fix)
Web display preview: Big values without footer line, like on the display
Web page: Core IP now in the Wi-Fi line after the network name (IP: …), removed next to Mojave
